Name: Zadok, Young Man of Valour
Summary: Young man mighty of valour who came to David at Hebron, of whose father's house were twenty and two captains.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:28: Young man mighty of valour who came to David at Hebron, of whose father's house were twenty and two captains.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zadok in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
